q1_integrated.question: Did P8 integrate P2/P3 into staging?
q1_integrated.answer: YES — Memory Quality P2 (minimal ingestion + Socratic Gate) and P3 (retention cleanup + user forget) are now part of the staging pack with policies, schemas, templates, prompts, and runtime scripts.

q2_ingestion_installable.question: Is memory ingestion quality now part of installable pack?
q2_ingestion_installable.answer: YES — Minimal ingestion policy, caveat enforcement, Socratic Gate, and validator are all included in the staging bundle.

q3_cleanup_installable.question: Is cleanup/user forget now part of installable pack?
q3_cleanup_installable.answer: YES — Cleanup planner with 5 modes (PLAN default), retention policy, inventory model, mount rules, and user forget boundary are all included.

q4_remains.question: What remains?
q4_remains.answer: Live execution testing of integrated pack. AB-0-R2 evidence integrity audit. User review before RC consideration.

q5_next.question: Recommended next?
q5_next.answer: FACTORY-AB-0-R2 (executed evidence integrity audit) OR RELEASE-CANDIDATE-0 (if user approves RC) OR USER-REVIEW-0.

q6_v05.question: Does v0.5 remain blocked?
q6_v05.answer: YES — v0.5 remains BLOCKED. Staging pack updated but 3 CRITICAL/HIGH blockers still active.
